visual_action: The video displays a screenshot of a tweet from Gavin Newsom. The tweet reads, "Our vote is in - now it's your turn, California. LFG!". It then cuts to a photograph of Gavin Newsom and a woman (Jennifer Siebel Newsom) standing together and smiling in what appears to be a polling location. Newsom is looking down at his ballot, and she is looking towards the camera.
